projectDescription: A SwiftUI file-tree component for macOS that colors entries by git status and watches for live changes on disk and in git.
keyFeatures: SwiftUI file-tree view for macOS 14+ with compact, gap-free rows
Real-time git status colors (modified, untracked, staged, deleted, ignored) per file and folder
Live FSEvents watching — reflects disk changes and git updates automatically
Nested git repository support (submodules and worktrees)
DevIcon font glyphs for hundreds of file types
Inline rename and create UI hooks — the host provides the field, the tree places it
Headless status API (register/snapshot) for git status without the view
Runtime-changeable theme (light/dark), hidden-file toggle, and selection
publicApiSurface: FileTree (class) — root, options, showHiddenFiles, theme, selection, inlineEdit, isPaused, rootMissing
FileTreeOptions (struct) — detectGit, canHaveMultipleGitRepositories, showHiddenFiles, showBranchNames, theme, showIndentGuides, fontSize, fontFamily, useDevIcons, colors
GitStatus (enum) — unmodified, modified, untracked, staged, deleted, ignored
TreeItemInfo (struct) — url, relativePath, isDirectory, isSymlink, repoRoot, gitStatus
FileTreeError (enum) — gitUnavailable, gitFailed(repo:message:), gitDetectionDisabled, pathOutsideRoot(_:), devIconsUnavailable
